messages:
linh: rolled coalescer+prefetch tuner to a tiny canary (g5-small, 8% traffic). early win: p50 down ~22% on short requests, effective token cost -9%.

rahul: great. what exactly changed in the tuner? any config to eyeball?

linh: defaults were too conservative for bursty tails. tuner now probes with short micro-warms then backs off if latency rises. also added a lightweight async-prefetch for likely next-prefixes. config below.

linh: snippet:

```
coalescer: {
  probe_interval_ms: 8,
  max_probe_ratio: 0.12,
  backoff_mult: 2.0,
  async_prefetch: true,
  prefetch_lookahead: 2,
  prefetch_budget: 3
}
```

ops-bot: canary-deploy 1987654321: applied to pool g5-canary-1 - 8% traffic. health: OK. p50: -22%. p95: +1%. cost/token: -9%.

peggy: any change in error/retry rates? prefetch can sometimes introduce stale kv reads.

linh: noticed a tiny increase in 409s (~0.03% of requests) due to prefetch races; added a soft-stale tolerance so callers can accept slightly older prefix while fetching fresh in background. no user-visible errors in smoke tests.

carlos: curious about metrics for prefix accuracy. did prefetch improve cache-hit ratio?

linh: cache-hit lift ~6% for 1-5 token flows; overall KV lookup rate +4% due to speculative prefetches but net CPU per token down.

rahul: please add model whitelist. some legacy models had prefetched prefixes that distorted scoring.

linh: done. only verified model ids are allowed for async-prefetch. also added a rollout flag in console.

peggy: can we get smoke evals posted? especially quality and hallucination checks.

linh: smoke summary: generation-regression: 0.0% (within noise), response-stability: +0.1, hallucination-probe: unchanged. attaching graphs in the release note.

rahul: if canary holds 24h, plan 40% by Fri morning. also schedule a short blurb for eng-all-hands.

linh: noted. will push release note and a one-pager with p50/p95 plots. thanks all :rocket:
